tasks.title: Core Setup, MongoDB Connection & Health Checks
tasks.acceptance_criteria: NestJS app initializes with ConfigModule, Mongoose connects to MongoDB, /health/live and /health/ready return 200 OK, Winston logging redacts sensitive tokens.

tasks.title: User Management & JWT Authentication Module
tasks.acceptance_criteria: POST /api/v1/auth/register hashes passwords with bcrypt; POST /api/v1/auth/login returns access (15m) and rotating refresh (7d) JWT tokens; POST /api/v1/auth/logout invalidates session; GET /api/v1/auth/me returns user profile; Nodemailer sends verification and reset emails.

tasks.title: Next.js App Shell, Navigation & Theme System
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI setup with dark/light theme toggle; responsive desktop sidebar with mobile drawer; Zustand auth store with token persistence; Axios client with automatic refresh-token interceptor.

tasks.title: Authentication & User Profile Pages
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Pages for /register, /login, /forgot-password, /reset-password, /verify-email, and /settings/profile with React Hook Form + Zod validation, error banners, and loading spinners.

tasks.title: Foundation & Auth Test Suite
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Unit tests for AuthService and JwtStrategy pass; integration tests for /api/v1/auth/* endpoints pass; Playwright E2E tests for registration, login, and auth guard redirects pass with >= 80% coverage.

tasks.title: Phase 1 Security & Architecture Review
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Code Review passes with status APPROVED and 0 CRITICAL or HIGH findings across JWT security, password hashing, MongoDB query sanitization, and CORS/Helmet configurations.

report.summary: Delivered NestJS 11 foundation, MongoDB connection, JWT auth with refresh rotation, SMTP mailer, Next.js 14 app shell with dark theme, auth/profile pages, and end-to-end test suites.

tasks.title: Provider Catalog & Models Module
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Mongoose schemas for provider_catalog and provider_models with indexes; GET /api/v1/providers and GET /api/v1/providers/:id/models return dynamic catalogue; admin endpoints allow adding/updating model metadata and freeQuotaPolicy.

tasks.title: User Provider Connections & Credential Encryption
tasks.acceptance_criteria: User provider credentials encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM (ciphertext, iv, authTag, keyVersion); CRUD for /api/v1/provider-connections with tenant isolation; POST /api/v1/provider-connections/:id/test tests connection without returning raw keys; credentials never exposed in logs or API responses.

tasks.title: Provider Catalog Explorer & Model View
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Providers page (/providers) displays provider cards with capabilities, supported aspect ratios/resolutions, duration limits, and billing badge (free_verified, trial, paid, unknown).

tasks.title: User API Keys Management & Testing Interface
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Settings → API Providers (/settings/providers) allows connecting keys with masked display (sk-****abcd); connection test button with status badges; region and custom label configuration; strict free-only toggle.

tasks.title: Provider Catalog & Encryption Test Suite
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Unit tests verify AES-256-GCM encryption, decryption, and key masking; integration tests verify tenant isolation on provider connections; Playwright E2E verifies adding and testing an API key.

tasks.title: Phase 2 BYOK Security Review
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Code Review passes with status APPROVED and 0 CRITICAL or HIGH findings; confirms plaintext API keys are never returned to client, never logged, and properly isolated per tenant.

report.summary: Delivered BYOK Provider Catalog with dynamic Mongoose schemas and default seed data, User Provider Connections with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest, connection test endpoint with key masking, Frontend Provider Catalog explorer (/providers), and User API Key settings with test interface (/settings/providers).

tasks.title: Video Projects & Scenes Data Module
tasks.acceptance_criteria: video_projects and video_scenes Mongoose schemas; project status state machine (draft, script_generating, awaiting_approval, queued, generating, rendering, completed, failed); CRUD endpoints /api/v1/projects with user ownership enforcement.

tasks.title: LLM Script & Scene Generation Engine
tasks.acceptance_criteria: POST /api/v1/projects/:id/script/generate parses user prompt into structured JSON scenes (narration, visualPrompt, plannedDurationSeconds, transition); respects provider duration boundaries; PATCH /projects/:id/script allows editing; POST /projects/:id/script/approve locks scene plan.

tasks.title: Video Creation Wizard
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Multi-step video creation wizard at /videos/new: prompt input, target duration (30/60/90/120s), aspect ratio (9:16, 16:9, 1:1), style, provider/model selector, pre-generation warnings for paid/unknown providers.

tasks.title: Script Review & Scene Prompt Editor
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Scene review screen (/videos/:id/edit-script): reorder scenes, edit visual and narration prompts, add/delete scenes, preview calculated duration, and approve script button.

tasks.title: Project & Script Planner Test Suite
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Unit tests for script parser JSON schema validation; integration tests for project CRUD and state transitions; Playwright E2E for video creation wizard and script approval flow.

tasks.title: Phase 3 Script & State Machine Review
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Code Review passes with status APPROVED and 0 CRITICAL or HIGH findings; confirms strict validation on script output and atomic state transitions preventing duplicate generation.

report.summary: Delivered Video Projects & Scenes data module with state machine transitions, LLM Script & Scene Generation engine, multi-step Video Creation Wizard (/videos/new), and Script Review & Scene Prompt Editor (/videos/:id/edit-script).

tasks.title: Provider Adapter Framework & Video Provider Integrations
tasks.acceptance_criteria: TypeScript VideoProviderAdapter interface; Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (Wan) adapter implementing validateCredentials, generateVideo, and getGenerationStatus; MockVideoProvider for local/CI automated testing without real API spend; normalized provider errors.

tasks.title: In-Process Generation Queue & S3 Asset Ingestion
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Asynchronous in-process scene queue with concurrency limits; polling processor with exponential backoff; safe HTTP download of provider clips with SSRF prevention; ffprobe stream and duration validation; Amazon S3 upload with tenant-scoped keys; media_assets records.

tasks.title: Real-Time Generation Progress Dashboard
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Project details screen (/videos/:id) showing generation progress bar, per-scene status badges (queued, generating, downloading, stored, failed), cancel project button, and retry failed scenes action.

tasks.title: Scene Clip Preview & Asset Inspector
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Preview individual generated scene video clips; display clip metadata (codec, resolution, duration); single-scene regenerate modal with prompt tweak.

tasks.title: Video Generation & Adapter Test Suite
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Unit tests for Wan adapter request/response normalization; integration tests for generation worker with mock adapter and S3 upload mocking; Playwright E2E testing progress polling and scene status updates.

tasks.title: Phase 4 Generation Pipeline & S3 Security Review
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Code Review passes with status APPROVED and 0 CRITICAL or HIGH findings; confirms SSRF protection on video downloads, no silent paid fallback, and secure S3 tenant key isolation.

tasks.title: FFmpeg Video Concatenation & Audio Mixing Engine
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Service invoking FFmpeg to normalize scene clips (H.264/AAC, target aspect ratio/fps), concatenate in sequence, mix voiceover narration and background music track, burn captions from SRT, and export final MP4.

tasks.title: Thumbnail Generation & Presigned S3 Delivery API
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Extract poster thumbnail from real video frame via FFmpeg; upload final video and thumbnail to S3; generate short-lived presigned GET URLs for preview and download; cleanup temporary render files.

tasks.title: Video Player & Render Progress Interface
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Finished video player at /videos/:id with custom playback controls, aspect-ratio container (9:16 vertical, 16:9 landscape, 1:1 square), render progress state, and retry render button.

tasks.title: Video Library, Download & Project Actions
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Videos index page (/videos) with grid/table view, filters by status and date, expiring download button, project duplication modal, and delete project with asset confirmation.

tasks.title: Render Engine & Media Delivery Test Suite
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Unit tests for FFmpeg parameter generation and ffprobe output parsing; integration tests for render lifecycle and presigned URL expiration; Playwright E2E for video playback, download link trigger, and project duplication.

tasks.title: Phase 5 Media Pipeline & Delivery Review
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Code Review passes with status APPROVED and 0 CRITICAL or HIGH findings; confirms command injection defense on FFmpeg calls, temp file descriptor cleanup, and S3 presigned URL expiration enforcement.

tasks.title: Provider Usage Tracking & User Limits Enforcement
tasks.acceptance_criteria: provider_usage collection logging every provider call with units/duration/cost estimate; middleware/guard enforcing daily/monthly job caps and max estimated cost per project; block paid/unknown providers toggle check.

tasks.title: Platform Administration & System Diagnostics API
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Admin endpoints (/api/v1/admin/*) protected by admin RBAC: GET /admin/dashboard, GET /admin/users with suspension toggle, GET/PATCH /admin/providers with emergency killswitch, GET /admin/jobs with failure logs, GET /admin/audit-logs.

tasks.title: Usage Analytics & User Limits Dashboard
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Usage dashboard (/usage) showing consumption charts by provider and model, daily/monthly job limit progress bars, estimated cost breakdown, and personal limit settings at /settings/limits.

tasks.title: Platform Admin Console
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Admin console (/admin): provider catalogue manager with killswitch button, global job monitor with failure diagnostics, user management table with suspend/activate actions, and system audit log viewer.

tasks.title: Usage, Admin & Full System E2E Regression Suite
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Unit tests for limit validation and free-only guard; integration tests for admin endpoints and audit logging; comprehensive Playwright E2E suite covering full lifecycle: user signup -> key setup -> project creation -> scene generation -> render -> usage tracking -> admin monitoring.

tasks.title: Phase 6 Final Production & Security Review
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Code Review passes with status APPROVED and 0 CRITICAL or HIGH findings; confirms admin RBAC lockdown, audit logging completeness, Datadog observability integration, and production readiness.
